name: oxview-vendored-deps
description: Not a real Node project - this file exists solely so Dependabot has an npm manifest to track the version of @silurus/ooxml vendored into inst/ooxml-dist by inst/prepare_lib.R. Nothing here is installed or run; when Dependabot opens a PR bumping the version below, update `ooxml_ver` in inst/prepare_lib.R to match and re-run it.
